title: Site settings
lead: Typed site settings, grouped by topic; one save bar for every change, secrets are never shown again.

site.title: Time zone
site.help: “Today” in the statistics starts at midnight in this time zone.

contest.title: Official contests
contest.help: Official contest mode: people who are not superusers cannot edit introductions or names, read or write comments, vote or post on the blog.

mail.title: Email
mail.help: The sender address and the SMTP server. An empty SMTP URL means email is not configured.

google.title: Sign in with Google
google.help: Turns on social sign-in: both a client id and a client secret are needed.

github.title: Sign in with GitHub
github.help: Turns on social sign-in: both a client id and a client secret are needed.

facebook.title: Sign in with Facebook
facebook.help: Turns on social sign-in: both a client id and a client secret are needed.

pwned.title: Leaked password check
pwned.help: The Have I Been Pwned range API address. Leave empty to turn the check off.

discord.title: Discord webhooks
discord.help: Each event is set, removed and tested on its own row; changes apply at once, no Save needed.

pdf.title: PDF export
pdf.help: The time and size limits of each problem statement PDF render.

similarity.title: Similarity detection
similarity.help: Each run keeps the pairs above these thresholds; it compares at most the newest submissions per problem and language family.

quota.title: Organization quota
quota.help: The monthly credits and test-data bytes an organization may use when staff set no limit of its own. “Warn only” records and shows overages; “Enforce” refuses them, and only takes effect once the problem data size backfill has finished.

problem.title: Deleting problems
problem.help: Days a deleted problem can be restored; after that its data is purged and only the code and name stay. Submissions are never deleted.

polygon.title: QHHOJ's Polygon account
polygon.help: QHHOJ reads Polygon problems with this account. Setters share a problem with it, then import it in Import from Polygon. Without a key or secret it is not connected.

externalJudge.title: External judge (PCD VJudge)
externalJudge.help: Problems linked to an external judge are submitted there and the verdict is copied back. Without a base URL and token it is not connected.

organization.title: Organization admin role
organization.help: The role given to every organization admin on becoming one (never taken away). Empty uses the role named "Org Admin".

contest.officialModeEndsAt: When official contest mode switches itself off

cost.problem: Credits to create or clone a problem
cost.contest: Credits to create or clone a contest
cost.dataPer10MiB: Credits per 10 MiB of uploaded data

problem.deleteGraceDays: Days a deleted problem can be restored

externalJudge.maxWaitMinutes: Minutes to wait for a verdict

contest.banAfterDisqualifications: An integer from 0 to 1000; 0 turns it off. Counts only contests that are not organization-only.
contest.officialModeEndsAt: An ISO 8601 instant with an offset, for example 2026-10-10T17:00:00+07:00. Empty: only the switch decides.

mail.from: An address or “Name <address>”, on one line.
mail.smtpUrl: smtp:// or smtps://, credentials percent-encoded. Never shown again.

auth.pwnedApiUrl: Empty or https. The live server does not accept internal addresses.

cost.dataPer10MiB: From 0 to 1000; each started 10 MiB counts once.

polygon.accountName: The Polygon account that owns the API key; shown in the how-to for setters.
polygon.apiKey: From Polygon: Settings, API keys. Encrypted when saved, never shown again.
polygon.apiSecret: Encrypted when saved, never shown again. After replacing it, test the connection again.

externalJudge.baseUrl: http:// or https://. Empty: not connected.
externalJudge.apiToken: Sent as a bearer token. Encrypted when saved, never shown again.
externalJudge.maxWaitMinutes: A whole number from 1 to 240. A run still unanswered after this is marked as a judge error.

secret.emptyKeeps: An empty box on save keeps the stored secret. To remove it, use “Clear secret”, not an empty box.

oauth.needsClientId: A client id is needed while enabled.
oauth.secretHint: The value is encrypted on save and never shown again. Leave empty to keep it.

webhooks.note: Each event goes to its own address, else to Default. Addresses are secret: only the host and the last 4 characters are shown.
webhooks.testQueued: Test message queued for {event}. Check the Discord channel; a bad address shows only there.
webhooks.removeBody: The address cannot be shown again; to restore it, paste it anew. Events without their own address then use Default.

errors.integer: Must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
errors.httpOrHttpsOrEmpty: Leave empty or use http:// or https://.

badValue.officialModeEndsAt: Not a valid instant. Use ISO 8601 with an offset, for example 2026-10-10T17:00:00+07:00.

revisions.title: History · {key}
revisions.subtitle: Newest first · 20 per page
revisions.footnote: A restore is written as a new revision in the history.
revisions.secretNote: A secret shows only “set” or “not set”, never a value.
revisions.notRestorable: A secret value cannot be restored.
revisions.confirmBody: The server sets the old value back and writes it as a new revision; the stored secret is kept.

reset.label: Reset to default {value}
reset.filled: Default filled in, not saved yet. Stored value: {stored}.

consequences.mailOff: Email goes back to “not configured” (empty URL).
consequences.notRestorable: The old value is not kept in the history: it cannot be restored.
consequences.providerOff: Sign-in with this provider is switched off at the same time, because the server refuses an enabled provider without a secret.
consequences.clientIdKept: The OAuth client id stays the same.
consequences.polygonOff: The Polygon connection stops: no listing, importing or syncing from Polygon until it is set again.
consequences.externalJudgeOff: The external judge connection stops: no search, verifying or submitting there until it is set again.

secrets.title: Secrets never appear in the log
secrets.body: A revision of a key with a secret records only “set / not set”, so a secret value cannot be restored.

search.label: Search settings
search.results: No setting matches | {n} setting matches | {n} settings match
